statements.subject: server
statements.description: Result: OK - delete completed. A tagged OK response is returned only if the mailbox has been deleted.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = Authenticated & mailbox.exists = true & mailbox.name != INBOX & mailbox.hasNoselect_with_inferiors = false

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Result: NO - delete failure: can't delete mailbox with that name. It is an error to attempt to delete INBOX or a mailbox name that does not exist.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = Authenticated & (mailbox.exists = false | mailbox.name = INBOX | mailbox.hasNoselect_with_inferiors = true)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Result: BAD - command unknown or arguments invalid.
statements.trigger: DELETE command received with invalid arguments

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server implementation does not permit deleting the name while inferior hierarchical names exist, then it SHOULD disallow the DELETE command by returning a tagged NO response. The NO response SHOULD include the HASCHILDREN response code.
statements.trigger: DELETE command received for mailbox with inferior hierarchical names
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = Authenticated & mailbox.has_inferior_names = true & mailbox.Noselect = false
actions: send tagged NO response with HASCHILDREN response code

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Alternatively, the server MAY allow the DELETE command, but it sets the \Noselect mailbox name attribute for that name.
statements.trigger: DELETE command received for mailbox with inferior hierarchical names
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = Authenticated & mailbox.has_inferior_names = true & mailbox.Noselect = false

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server decides to convert (normalize) the mailbox name, it SHOULD return an untagged LIST with the "\NonExistent" attribute and OLDNAME extended data item.
statements.trigger: DELETE command received with mailbox name requiring normalization
actions: send untagged LIST response with \NonExistent attribute and OLDNAME data item

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Mailboxes deleted in one IMAP session MAY be announced to other IMAP sessions using an unsolicited LIST response, containing the "\NonExistent" attribute.
actions: send unsolicited LIST response with \NonExistent attribute to other sessions
